description: Additive model with no deny, no access summary, no kill switch, no audit history. Revocation incomplete.
Per-asset and per-user access summaries. Revocation feedback: "still has access through N paths."
Revoke-all per user and per asset. One-click kill switch. Logged.
Project lockdown (freeze all external access). Audit log with historical queries. Revoked grants retained.
Explicit block: per-user per-asset override. Rare, visible, logged, reversible. The one exception to additive.
Deny-by-default experiment. Realized additive already IS deny-by-default (no access without a grant). The real issue was multi-path revocation, already solved.
Reframe: "no access by default, explicit grants" as the lead principle. Clearer than "additive."
